interactive.label: data_folder
interactive.tooltip: Folder with the burst (.bur) tables of a finished burst analysis; the photons they name are read from beside them.

interactive.label: min_states
interactive.tooltip: Smallest number of states tried.

interactive.label: max_states
interactive.tooltip: Largest number of states tried.

interactive.label: patience
interactive.tooltip: Stop the state-count scan once the criterion has risen this many times (about 1.6 times faster); -1 fits every state count.

interactive.label: restarts
interactive.tooltip: Random initialisations per state count; the best log-likelihood wins.

interactive.label: seed
interactive.tooltip: Seed of the restarts: the same seed refits to the same answer.

interactive.label: max_iter
interactive.tooltip: Maximum EM iterations per fit.

interactive.label: min_photons
interactive.tooltip: Bursts with fewer stream photons are left out.

interactive.label: time_scale
interactive.tooltip: Integer down-scaling of macro times (coarser base unit); raise it when the fit is slow.

interactive.label: divisors
interactive.tooltip: Split each stream into this many micro-time bins so states of equal E but different lifetime separate; 1 is off.

interactive.label: Photon table HDF5
interactive.tooltip: Write h2mm_photons.h5: compact and fast to reload.

interactive.label: Photon table CSV
interactive.tooltip: Write h2mm_photons.csv: what every other tool can open.

interactive.label: decoder_seed
interactive.tooltip: Seed of the sampling decoders.

interactive.label: Write state photons
interactive.tooltip: Write the decoded assignment back beside each source measurement.

interactive.label: State photons as PTU
interactive.tooltip: A PTU whose routing channels encode (stream, state).

interactive.label: State photons sidecar
interactive.tooltip: A msgpack sidecar; the source file is left untouched.
